title: Travel Completed | APPR | Group Booking | Claim Self Only | Delay 6-<9 hrs | BAsic Aeroplan Profile
description:
Validates an end-to-end flight disruption claim for a passenger traveling under a group booking (12 passengers on PNR) who files a self-only claim. The system detects the group booking identifier, restricts claim processing strictly to the authenticated claimant (Jean-Pierre Martin), and does not expose the other 11 passenger details for privacy. The single domestic leg (Flight AC 301, YUL?YYZ) is delayed 7 hours (6�<9h band) due to controllable documentation/dispatch/system issues (Code 31). APPR applies at Tier 2 compensation ($700 CAD Cash or $840 CAD AC Wallet with +20% bonus). The claimant's Basic Aeroplan profile is linked, both Cash and AC Wallet options are presented, and the customer selects Cash (Interac e-Transfer to Canada). Validates Persona IDV PASS, CyberSource GREEN, full automated case creation, and Claims Dashboard validation reflecting single-claimant group booking resolution.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC013 � 12 passengers (Group booking flag: TRUE in PNR / Trip Tracer). Claimant: Jean-Pierre Martin (Adult - Basic Aeroplan Member 9871234567, 1 of 12). Journey: 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ (Flight AC 301). Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 21:00 (7hr delay � Delay band: 6 to <9 hours). Arrival delay code: 31 (Documentation / Dispatch / System Issue � Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+13). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan: Linked (9871234567), Basic Member in good standing. CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. Persona: Configured to return IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD).
